title: CRGD
description: Lightweight modpack centered around Create, with various quality of life features.
body:
# Summary
Intended to provide a version of Minecraft with minimal changes, along with Create and various Quality of Life improvements. Additionally contains some optimization mods.

# Mod Highlights
- The create mod and multiple additions to it are featured. Gives the ability to create elaborate farms and multiple methods of transportation, along with some weaponry. Notably includes the Create Aeronautics mod, which allows for high-tech aircrafts.
- Some mods will alter the environment. Tectonic allows for more unique biomes, like massive mountains or beautiful lakes inside caves. Dungeons and Taverns will add more unique structures, and Farmers Delight will add new food items to farm.
- New item inclusions include working TV's via Vista, or custom music discs with VinURL.
- UI improvements like a minimap (Xaero's Minimap), better shulker box information (Shulker Box Tooltip), more intuitive way to view hunger bar info (Appleskin), and an improved way to view crafting recipies (JEI)
- Many other enhancements like optimization mods, lighting mods, and shaders are included as well.
